portal_description:
A flaw was found in the Dockerfile instructions of the Service Registry Operand images where the ownership of the artifact added using the ADD instruction was assigned to the machine user who built the image. This flaw caused an error that prevented users from pulling down the images because the UID value was outside of the defined range of the host's user namespace.

Users of these images are also encouraged to rebuild all container images that depend on these images.

You can find the images updated by this advisory in the Red Hat Container Catalog (see References).
